#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, using pypdf (per the pdf skill)."""
import datetime
import os
import shutil
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def esc(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def make_pdf(path: str, elements: list) -> None:
    """Build a minimal, valid single-page PDF with Helvetica text/graphics."""
    content = ""
    for el in elements:
        kind = el["kind"]
        if kind == "text":
            content += (
                f"BT /F1 {el['size']:.1f} Tf {el['color']} rg "
                f"{el['x']:.1f} {el['y']:.1f} Td ({esc(el['text'])}) Tj ET\n"
            )
        elif kind == "rect":
            content += (
                f"{el['color']} rg {el['x0']:.1f} {el['y0']:.1f} "
                f"{el['w']:.1f} {el['h']:.1f} re f\n"
            )
        elif kind == "line":
            content += (
                f"{el['color']} RG {el['w']:.1f} w {el['x0']:.1f} {el['y0']:.1f} "
                f"m {el['x1']:.1f} {el['y1']:.1f} l S\n"
            )
    content_bytes = content.encode("latin-1")
    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>\n",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>\n",
        (
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>\n"
        ),
        (
            b"<< /Length " + str(len(content_bytes)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
            + content_bytes + b"\nendstream\n"
        ),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>\n",
    ]
    out = [b"%PDF-1.4\n"]
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, 1):
        offsets.append(sum(len(x) for x in out))
        out.append(f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode())
        out.append(obj)
        out.append(b"endobj\n")
    xref_pos = sum(len(x) for x in out)
    out.append(b"xref\n")
    out.append(f"0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode())
    out.append(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for off in offsets:
        out.append(f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode())
    out.append(b"trailer\n")
    out.append(f"<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n".encode())
    out.append(b"startxref\n")
    out.append(f"{xref_pos}\n".encode())
    out.append(b"%%EOF\n")
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(b"".join(out))


def center_x(text: str, size: float) -> float:
    # Approximate Helvetica width (~0.5 * font size per character)
    return (PAGE_W - len(text) * size * 0.5) / 2.0


def main() -> None:
    today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print("Using date:", today)

    # --- Build the cover page ---
    cover_elements = [
        # Navy header band
        {"kind": "rect", "color": "0.11 0.16 0.35",
         "x0": 0, "y0": 660, "w": PAGE_W, "h": 132},
        # Title
        {"kind": "text", "text": "Annual Financial Report", "size": 30,
         "color": "1 1 1",
         "x": center_x("Annual Financial Report", 30), "y": 726},
        # Current date
        {"kind": "text", "text": today, "size": 16,
         "color": "0.25 0.28 0.32",
         "x": center_x(today, 16), "y": 610},
        # Rule under the date
        {"kind": "line", "color": "0.55 0.58 0.62", "w": 1,
         "x0": 186, "y0": 596, "x1": 426, "y1": 596},
    ]
    make_pdf("cover_page_tmp.pdf", cover_elements)

    # --- Source report (create a basic body if report.pdf does not exist) ---
    original_exists = os.path.exists("report.pdf")
    if original_exists:
        source = PdfReader("report.pdf")
        shutil.copy("report.pdf", "report_backup_original.pdf")
        print("Found existing report.pdf; backed it up to report_backup_original.pdf")
    else:
        body_elements = [
            {"kind": "text", "text": "Report Contents", "size": 24,
             "color": "0 0 0", "x": 72, "y": 700},
            {"kind": "text",
             "text": "This document contains the annual financial report.",
             "size": 12, "color": "0 0 0", "x": 72, "y": 660},
            {"kind": "line", "color": "0.5 0.5 0.5", "w": 1,
             "x0": 72, "y0": 648, "x1": 540, "y1": 648},
            {"kind": "text",
             "text": "Financial statements and analysis follow.",
             "size": 12, "color": "0 0 0", "x": 72, "y": 620},
        ]
        make_pdf("report_body_tmp.pdf", body_elements)
        source = PdfReader("report_body_tmp.pdf")
        print("report.pdf not found; created a basic body to accompany the cover.")

    # --- Merge: cover page first, then the report body ---
    cover = PdfReader("cover_page_tmp.pdf")
    writer = PdfWriter()
    for page in cover.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    for page in source.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open("report_with_cover_tmp.pdf", "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    os.replace("report_with_cover_tmp.pdf", "report.pdf")
    print(f"Wrote report.pdf with {len(writer.pages)} page(s) "
          f"(cover page + {len(source.pages)} report page(s)).")

    # Clean up temporary artifacts
    for tmp in ("cover_page_tmp.pdf", "report_body_tmp.pdf"):
        if os.path.exists(tmp):
            os.remove(tmp)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
